name: Sebayeng/Dikgale Regional Water Scheme
status_note: Phase 10 reached practical completion (contract Jan to Sept 2024, Annual report 2024/25). The next phase was at 0% against a 35% target in June 2026; detailed design under way, construction expected to start in July to Sept 2026 (Q4 report 2025/26)

MSW states on its own website that it did design and construction monitoring of the scheme from 2011
note: Multi-phase bulk scheme running since 2011, supplying 30+ villages from the Ebenezer bulk line. Phase 10 targeted Sebayeng, Dikgale, Potse, Ntsima and Syferkuil (118 households, 34 jobs). The 2026/27 SDBIP plans 2 200 m of reticulation, 1 000 m of pumping main, 2 storage tanks, 2 equipped boreholes and 20 communal standpipes by June 2027.
